intro: Finer time connectors: at once, at that moment, gradually, each time, and once something is done.
p.apenas.consejo: With the future it takes the subjunctive: «apenas llegues, llámame». With the past, the indicative: «apenas llegó, me llamó».
p.nada más.consejo: It goes with an infinitive: «nada más llegar, me llamó». It shows one action follows another at once.
p.a medida que.consejo: It describes a gradual change. With real facts, the indicative: «a medida que pasan las horas».
p.conforme.consejo: Here it is a conjunction of time: «conforme pasa el tiempo». It is used a lot in writing.
p.cada vez que.consejo: With habitual or past facts, the indicative: «cada vez que llamo». The z in «vez» sounds «th».
p.desde que.consejo: It marks the start of something that goes on: «desde que vivo aquí». It takes the indicative.
p.una vez que.consejo: It marks what is already done: «una vez que termines». With the future, the subjunctive.
p.mientras tanto.consejo: It links two simultaneous actions. It goes at the start of the sentence, with a comma: «mientras tanto, espera».
p.a los dos días.consejo: It counts from a moment in the past: «a los dos días, llamó». Alternative: «dos días después».
p.equipo.consejo: It is masculine: «el equipo». It is also the set of devices for a job.
p.despacho.consejo: It is one person's room, not the whole company. The «ch» sounds as in «chocolate».
p.duda.consejo: You say «tener una duda». It is feminine: «una duda».
b1.texto:
- at once: **en cuanto**, **tan pronto como**, **apenas** + clause; **nada más** + infinitive. **Nada más llegar**, me llamó.
- at that moment: **al** + infinitive. **Al entrar**, vi a Ana.
- gradually: **a medida que**, **conforme**. **A medida que** pasa el tiempo, lo entiendo mejor.
- each time: **cada vez que**, **siempre que**
- from, up to: **desde que**, **hasta que**
- once done: **una vez que** + clause; **una vez** + participle. **Una vez terminada** la reunión, nos fuimos.

The mood follows the rule of **cuando**. The future takes the subjunctive: **apenas llegues**, llámame. The past and habits take the indicative: **apenas llegó**, me llamó.

Later on: **a los dos días**, **al cabo de** un mes, dos años **después**.
b2.f0.texto: As soon as I arrived at the office, I was introduced to the whole team.
b2.f2.texto: On entering, I saw there was no computer.
b2.f3.texto: As soon as you have the computer, I'll explain everything to you.
b2.f4.texto: As the hours go by, I feel calmer.
b2.f5.texto: Every time you have a question, ask me.
b2.f6.texto: Once the meeting is over, will you show me the program?
b2.f7.texto: In the meantime, read these documents.
b2.f8.texto: Since I arrived, everything seems new to me.
b2.f9.texto: After two days you will already know everyone.
b4.texto:
- **At once**: en cuanto, tan pronto como, apenas + clause; nada más + infinitive.
- **At that moment**: al + infinitive.
- **Gradually**: a medida que, conforme.
- **Each time**: cada vez que, siempre que.
- **From, up to**: desde que, hasta que.
- **Once done**: una vez que + clause; una vez + participle.

The mood follows the rule of «cuando»: the future takes the subjunctive (apenas llegues, llámame); the past and habits take the indicative (apenas llegó, me llamó).
b4.e0.texto: As time goes by, I understand it better.
b4.e1.texto: As soon as she arrived, she called me.
b4.e2.texto: As soon as we went out, it started to rain.
b5.f0.texto: The office wakes up with a soft hum of keyboards and voices.
b5.f1.texto: As soon as she walks in, Carla smells the freshly made coffee.
b5.f2.texto: At the far end, a large window lets in a white, clean light.
b5.f3.texto: As the sun rises, the shadows of the desks grow shorter.
b5.f4.texto: Every time someone laughs, the air seems lighter.
b5.f5.texto: Meanwhile, the clock on the wall moves on unhurriedly.
b5.f6.texto: Once the meeting is over, the team goes out into the corridor in small groups.
b5.f7.texto: Carla presses her notebook to her chest and looks around her.
b5.f8.texto: Since she walked through the door, everything seems bigger to her.
b5.f9.texto: After two days, that office will already be a home of bright windows.
b6.frase: Nada más ____ a la oficina, la llamé.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «nada más» goes with an infinitive.
b6.o1.refuerzo: It is a conjugated verb. After «nada más» comes the infinitive.
b6.o2.refuerzo: It is subjunctive. After «nada más» comes the infinitive.
b6.pregunta: After «nada más» a specific form goes.
b7.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «al» + infinitive is «when» at that moment.
b7.o1.refuerzo: No: «al salir» is the same moment, not long after.
b7.o2.refuerzo: That would be said «antes de salir».
b8.frase: Cada vez que tenía una duda alguien me ayudaba
b8.traduccion: Every time I had a question, someone helped me
b9.o0.refuerzo: That is it: a future action goes in the subjunctive.
b9.o1.refuerzo: It is indicative: it serves for the past or habits, not for the future.
b9.o2.refuerzo: The future is not used after «apenas»; the subjunctive is.
b9.pregunta: It is a future action: choose the mood.
b11.o0: la reunión acabó una sola vez
b11.o0.refuerzo: No: «una vez» + participle is «when it was already finished».
b11.o1: cuando la reunión ya había acabado
b11.o1.refuerzo: Well done: it marks what is already done.
b11.o2.refuerzo: It is the opposite: it is after it ends.
b12.frase: A medida que ____ el tiempo, lo entiendo mejor.
b12.o0.refuerzo: Yes: a general process goes in the indicative.
b12.o1.refuerzo: The subjunctive would look only to the future; here it is a real process.
b12.o2.refuerzo: It is an infinitive. «A medida que» needs a conjugated verb.
b12.pregunta: A general process takes the indicative: complete.
p.presentaron.consejo: Past tense of «presentar», to introduce. Stress on TA.
p.explico.consejo: From «explicar», to explain. The x sounds ks: eks-PLI-ko.
p.pregúntame.consejo: «Me» at the end means «me». The accent marks the stress on GUN.
p.terminada.consejo: Feminine of «terminado». Stress on NA: ter-mi-NA-da.
p.enseñas.consejo: From «enseñar», to show or teach. The ñ sounds ny.
p.documentos.consejo: Plural of «documento». Stress on MEN: do-ku-MEN-tos.
p.conocerás.consejo: Future of «conocer», to know. The c before o is k, and the c before e is th.
p.empezó.consejo: Past tense of «empezar», to begin. The z is th in Spain.
p.teclados.consejo: Plural of «teclado», keyboard. Stress on LA: tek-LA-dos.
p.cortas.consejo: Feminine plural of «corto», short. Stress on KOR.
p.avanza.consejo: From «avanzar», to advance. The v sounds like b and the z like th.
p.grupos.consejo: Plural of «grupo», group. Stress on GRU: GRU-pos.
p.cruzó.consejo: Past tense of «cruzar», to cross. The z is th, and the accent is on the o.
p.llamé.consejo: Past tense of «llamar», to call. The ll sounds like y. Stress on ME.
p.momento.consejo: Masculine, «el momento». In «en ese momento» it means «at that time».
p.ayudaba.consejo: Imperfect of «ayudar», to help. Stress on DA: a-yu-DA-ba.
p.acabado.consejo: Participle of «acabar», to finish. Stress on BA: a-ka-BA-do.
